about_the_game:
Welcome to the Dread Cabin — a whole new chapter in creative hair styling!

Master the art of crafting beautiful dreadlocks with the innovative Dreadmaker tool. Whether you're designing thick, thin, or curly locks, the possibilities are endless. Shape and style dreadlocks for both head and beard, adjusting lengths with scissors, razors or trimmers to create the perfect look.

Take full control by customizing every detail — reposition locks with ease, recolor to match your client's unique style, and add a finishing touch with over 15 stunning new rings and beads!

Immerse yourself in more than 30 exciting scenarios that will challenge and inspire you, or let your imagination run wild in the Creative Mode. From bold hairstyles to unforgettable beard designs, the Dread Cabin offers endless opportunities to design truly unique looks.

Are you ready to twist, style and accessorize like never before?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 equivalent or greater
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290 or greater
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3, Meta Quest 3S, HTC Vive, Valve Index
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required
